outcome: Mode of birth (vaginal, planned or unplanned caesarean delivery)
cohort: All twin births in Victoria, Australia, from January 1, 1983 to December 31, 2015 (32,187 twin pregnancies ending in live or stillbirths)
finding: The proportion of twins born by caesarean delivery in Victoria almost tripled between 1983 and 2015, largely due to the increasing preference for caesarean delivery in twin pregnancies.
mod_finding: The proportion of twin births by planned caesarean delivery with twin pregnancy as the sole indication for caesarean delivery increased from 1.8% to 21% between 1983 and 2015.
